a real agency requirement, or a real deadline.

SYNTHETIC PROGRAM AWARD TERMS AND CONDITIONS

Section I. Reporting Requirements

Recipients must submit a quarterly progress report describing activities
completed during the reporting period.

The recipient is required to submit an annual performance report summarizing
outcomes against the approved work plan.

A final report must be submitted at the conclusion of the period of performance.

Grantees are encouraged to report promising practices to the program office.

Section II. Financial Requirements

Recipients must submit a federal financial report using SF-425 on a semi-annual
basis.

The recipient shall maintain documentation supporting all drawdown requests.

Organizations expending more than the applicable threshold in federal awards in
a fiscal year are required to obtain a single audit.

Section III. Performance and Data

The recipient must collect participant data sufficient to report on each
performance measure identified in the approved work plan.

The recipient is required to submit demographic data for individuals served.

Section IV. Compliance

The recipient must retain records for the period specified in the award terms.

A tribal resolution authorizing participation is required to be submitted before
funds are released.

Subrecipients must submit quarterly financial reports to the recipient, and the
recipient shall monitor subrecipient performance.

Section V. Closeout

The recipient must submit a final financial report as part of closeout.

All closeout documents are required to be submitted within 90 days of the end of
the period of performance.

Section VI. Application Instructions

The application package must include a budget narrative with your application.
This requirement applies at time of application and does not continue after
award.
